title: [R3] selectChat races with EventSource; messageState not atomic
description:
Race condition in selectChat flow:
1. User clicks chat → selectChat(chatId) at line 291
2. fetchMessages(chatId) called at line 299
3. While Message/get+query in flight, EventSource state event arrives
4. Handler calls Message/changes with OLD messageState (from previous chat or null)
5. Message/changes returns changes for wrong state window or wrong chat

symptom: Messages may not sync correctly when user switches chats quickly or state events arrive during chat load.

Root cause: messageState is not atomically updated with sinceState. Between fetchMessages start and completion, a state event can use stale messageState.

Fix: Either (a) queue state events while message fetch is in flight, or (b) make messageState update atomic with the sinceState comparison.
notes: opinion: JS is single-threaded; async interleaving at await points cannot corrupt messageState — worst case is one redundant /changes call that returns empty delta
